questions.prompt: What is the big idea of Emperor Penguins and Their Relatives?

Only penguins are flightless birds whose wings work as swimming flippers.
Only a male balances one egg on his feet beneath warm skin.
questions.answer: Penguins have traits that help them live in different places.
questions.rationale: Penguins are flightless birds whose wings work as swimming flippers. A male balances one egg on his feet beneath warm skin.
